title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Tea Party on 1969-12-31
lineage: SBD > Reel Master > 2 cassette generations > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy NYE ’69 show with standout jams and solid performances, captured on a soundboard that’s mostly clear but shows some cassette hiss.
ai_review.review: The December 31 1969 Boston Tea Party concert is praised for its driving set‑list – highlights include High Time, Black Peter, Uncle John’s Band, Alligator, Mason’s Children and the rare Slewfoot – and a particularly fiery trading duel between Jerry and Phil.  The SBD source sounds decent overall; most listeners find it listenable despite occasional hiss and a slightly distant feel from multiple cassette generations.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.8 / 5 across 24 reviews; the majority praise both performance and sound, with only a few noting modest tape‑generation noise.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several listeners mention audible hiss and a distant feel due to multiple cassette generations, but most describe the mix as clear with good vocals and overall listenable balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relatively “light” NYE set packed with straight‑up songs and high‑octane jams, delivering a powerful close to the decade.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His tone is repeatedly described as magnificent; reviewers note the emotion and intensity of his playing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for strong bass work and an exciting trading duel with Jerry.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for solid chording underneath the band, though one reviewer mentions his guitar gets buried in the mix.
